title: Length of the Credit Relationship and Step Points on Permanent Increases (Commercial Credit Account)
content:
**Credit policy manual — account age.** The time since a Commercial Credit Account opened adds percentage points to **the step percentage used** on a permanent increase.

The step percentage used gains five percentage points for an account opened one hundred eighty or more whole months before today, two points for one opened eighty-four to one hundred seventy-nine whole months before today, and none otherwise.

Whole months run from the account's opened date to today: the difference in calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the opened date's day of the month, with no move of a month-end date to a shorter month's last day.

| Whole months since the account opened | Points |
|---|---|
| 180 or more (fifteen years) | 5 |
| 84 to 179 (seven years up to fifteen) | 2 |
| fewer than 84 | 0 |

*Boundary, hypothetical (today 31 October):* an account opened 31 October seven years earlier has 84 whole months and earns 2 points; one opened 1 November seven years earlier has 83 and earns none.
